title: persea carolinensis f. pubescens
intro: Persea carolinensis f. pubescens, commonly known as the American spice tree or Red Bay, is a tree species native to the southeastern United States. This tree has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Persea carolinensis f. pubescens include analgesic, anti-catarrhal, and expectorant effects, which can help to relieve pain, reduce congestion, and promote coughing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, particularly camphor, bornyl acetate, and safrole, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
